root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: ctxt->nsdb != NULL while parsing entity replacement content in reader mode
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Entity parsing must use an isolated parser namespace database so entity-owned nodes do not inherit namespace bindings from the surrounding reader-owned tree.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable reader-mode entity parse leaves ctxt->nsdb unset for the entity-content parse, so retained entity children keep aliases to reader-owned xmlNs objects. The fixed code creates a dedicated namespace database before parsing entity content, and the required assertion distinguishes the two versions at that root site.

nodes.state: When reader-mode entity expansion reloads the retained child list, the vulnerable child still carries a non-NULL namespace pointer.
At namespace fixup, xmlStaticCopyNode looks up and uses the same namespace object referenced by the copied node.

edges.relation: The same parsed entity child list stored on ent->children is later reloaded for reader-mode expansion.
The namespace list freed during reader cleanup is the same namespace pointer later still referenced by the retained entity child.
The stale namespace pointer on the reloaded entity child is the namespace object later resolved and dereferenced by xmlStaticCopyNode.
